component.name: Lantronix Network Tool
component.summary: Find Lantronix device servers on the network and assign an IP address

description.p: Asks every Lantronix device server on the local network (XPort, UDS, EDS, MSS, WiPort …) for its IP and MAC address with the Lantronix discovery protocol, and opens its web interface. Devices without a usable address get a temporary one the ARP way.
